title: KestrelCare Repair Benefits: General Terms
content:
**Article 1.** Benefits under KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts are paid only with an approved claim.

**Article 2 — Rental.** The clause "Rental is reimbursed at the plan's rental per day for each night the covered repair keeps the vehicle, up to the plan's rental maximum days per visit;" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for rental car reimbursements.

**Article 3 — Towing.** Towing to the repairing facility is reimbursed up to the plan's towing per occurrence.

**Article 4 — Trip interruption.** The clause "trip interruption lodging and meals at the plan's per-day amount up to its maximum days when the breakdown happens at least the minimum distance from the holder's residential address." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for trip interruption reimbursements.

**Article 5 — Receipts.** The clause "Receipts must be submitted within the benefit receipt submission days after the repair is completed, and each benefit type is reimbursed once per repair order." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for benefit receipts.

**Article 6 — Effect on the limit.** Benefits do not reduce the coverage remaining.

**Article 7 — Plan status.** A benefit is reimbursed only on a plan whose status is active or exhausted, as the service contract record shows it.

| Plan status on the record | Benefit reimbursed |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| exhausted | yes |
| pending, expired, cancelled or transferred | no |

*Hypothetical case:* a KestrelCare Gold plan whose aggregate limit was used up by the claim payment on a repair shows as exhausted; a towing cost on that approved repair can still be reimbursed, up to the towing per occurrence of KestrelCare Gold, and the reimbursement leaves the coverage remaining at zero.
